title: RenderRequest
description: POST /api/render (contract §2.6, §4.7). A model that isn't listed, an image that isn't a JPEG (or whose size can't be read) and keep_room without scene or mask are 400; an unknown scene is 404.

image.description: The capture: the full photo frame with the furniture.

prompt.description: Replaces the default prompt when it isn't blank.

scene.description: The scene rendered; required for the reference photo and keep-room (§4.7).

layout.description: The layout shown; a value that isn't a slug is recorded as null. With room, a room layout.

room.description: The room the render was made in (contract §4.9): needs scene, the member photo shown (400 when scene is missing or isn't a member; 404 for an unknown room). The capture, the reference photo and keep-room are that photo's, exactly as without a room.

keep_room.description: Keep room exact (§4.7): needs scene and mask.

mask.description: Items white on black at the photo's size (keep_room only).
